description: §40.2 (S443 review F2) — one file declares `<program auth="none">` and `<page auth="required">`. A route is one file and one served document, so the stricter declaration wins (the route is gated) and W-AUTH-FILE-CONFLICT surfaces the overridden laxer declaration.
rationale: §40.2 (S443): 'a `<page auth="required">` anywhere in a file makes that file's route the gated scope, and a laxer `auth=` elsewhere in the same file … does not relax it … The compiler SHALL emit `W-AUTH-FILE-CONFLICT` naming both declarations and stating that the stricter one wins.'
